title: Custom Software Engineering Lead
tagsAndSkills: advanced analytics,cloud engineer,cloud migration,ai,agile development,agile delivery,analytics,cloud
jobDescription:
Project Role : Custom Software Engineering Lead

Project Role Description : Own the technical direction and architecture of custom software solutions, leading teams through design and delivery. Set development standards and ensure code quality, scalability, and performance aligned to business objectives.

Must have skills : Data Engineering

Good to have skills : Data Modeling Techniques and Methodologies, DevOps, Generative AI
Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary
As a Data Engineer lead, you will lead the design, development, and implementation of scalable data engineering solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build modern data platforms, develop high-performance data pipelines, and enable advanced analytics while providing technical leadership and mentoring engineering teams.

Roles Responsibilities
  • Lead the design, development, and optimization of scalable data engineering solutions and data pipelines.
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes, data lakes, and data warehouse solutions.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, data scientists, and cross-functional teams to deliver data-driven solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, governance, security, and performance across enterprise data platforms.
  • Mentor team members, conduct code reviews, and drive engineering best practices.
  • Lead technical discussions, solution design, and Agile delivery activities.
  • Leverage Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Composer, and Pub/Sub to develop scalable cloud-native data solutions.
  • Stay updated with emerging trends in Data Engineering, Big Data, and GCP technologies.

    Professional Technical Skills
    Must Have Skills
  • 1012 years of experience in Data Engineering with strong expertise in enterprise data solutions.
  • Hands-on experience including BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Composer, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, and Cloud SQL.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, SQL, Java, or Scala.
  • Experience with Apache Spark, Apache Beam, ETL/ELT development, and real-time data processing.
  • Strong understanding of Data Modeling, Data Lakes, Data Warehousing, Data Governance, and Data Quality.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, Terraform, and Agile development methodologies.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
  • Good to Have Skills
  • Experience with Looker, Vertex AI, Dataplex, BigLake, Datastream, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Data Catalog.
  • Exposure to Generative AI, Machine Learning, Docker, Kubernetes (GKE), Kafka, and dbt.
  • Experience in cloud migration, data modernization, and Industry X projects.

    Additional Information
  • The candidate should have 1012 years of overall experience, with at least 7+ years of relevant GCP Data Engineering experience.
  • Prior experience leading technical teams and delivering enterprise cloud data solutions is preferred.
  • Preferred Certifications: Google Professional Data Engineer, Google Professional Cloud Architect, Google Associate Cloud Engineer, or Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer.
  • This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
  • A minimum of 15 years of full-time education is required.

    Qualification 15 years full time education

Summary:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Agentic AI Developer to design, architect, and deliver next-generation intelligent agent solutions powered by Large Language Models (LLMs). The ideal candidate will bring deep hands-on expertise in building agentic AI systems using LangChain and LangGraph, and deploying scalable, enterprise-grade solutions leveraging Azure OpenAI (GPT-5.0 and above). This role focuses on developing autonomous, reasoning-driven AI agents capable of solving complex business problems, orchestrating workflows, and driving intelligent automation at scale.

Key Roles and Responsibilities:

1. Solution Architecture Design
Architect end-to-end Agentic AI solutions using modern frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph.
Design multi-agent systems with capabilities like reasoning, planning, memory, and tool orchestration.
Define scalable architectures for distributed agents aligned with enterprise needs and cloud best practices.
Translate business problems into AI-driven workflows and agent-based solutions.

2. Development Implementation
Build and deploy intelligent agents using Azure OpenAI services and advanced GPT models.
Develop stateful, multi-step agent workflows leveraging LangGraph constructs such as nodes, edges, and shared state.
Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), tool integrations, and external API orchestration.
Create reusable agent components, prompt templates, and orchestration pipelines.

3. LLM Agent Optimization
Fine-tune prompts, workflows, and agent decision-making loops (ReAct, planning agents, etc.).
Optimize performance, latency, cost, and response quality of LLM-based systems.
Implement memory management (short-term, long-term, vector-based).

4. Enterprise Integration Deployment
Integrate agents into enterprise ecosystems (APIs, databases, enterprise apps).
Deploy solutions on Azure cloud, ensuring scalability, security, and reliability.
Work with DevOps teams for CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and observability.

5. Governance, Security Responsible AI
Ensure compliance with Responsible AI, data privacy, and security standards.
Implement guardrails, validation layers, and safe AI practices.
Participate in design reviews and risk assessments.

6. Collaboration Leadership
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product, QA, DevOps, Business).
Mentor junior developers and contribute to best practices and reusable frameworks.
Drive innovation through POCs, accelerators, and reusable assets.

Core Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience with: LangChain LangGraph for agent orchestration Azure OpenAI (GPT-5.0 or higher) and LLM-based application development
Deep understanding of: Agentic AI concepts: reasoning, planning, autonomy, tool usage Multi-agent systems and orchestration

Cloud DevOps

Job Summary:



  • As a Product Manager for Accenture LearnVantage (ALV), you will own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for our enterprise learning platform. 

  • You will translate ambiguous business needs into a clear, prioritised roadmap and drive it to execution with engineering, design, and business teams.

jobDescription:
Overview
We are seeking a Deputy Director Service Modernization AI-led Engineering to lead the global service management product and engineering transformation of PepsiCos IT ecosystem, driving an AI-first, data-driven, engineering-led, and experience-focused operating model across a large, multi-disciplinary organization.
This role owns the IT Service Management product and operating model spanning Process, Service Experience, Automation, AI-led Engineering, Reliability, and Continuous Improvement and leads service modernization initiatives that simplify ways of working, enable product-led capabilities, automate operations, and embed intelligent, self-healing patterns into the enterprise IT ecosystem.
You will manage managers, senior engineering leads, and strategic vendors across a global organization, drive modernization and engineering portfolios, and represent Service Management product capability to PepsiCo leadership
Responsibilities
  • Own and evolve the IT Service Management product and operating model, integrating Process Management, Service Experience, Automation, AI-led Engineering, Reliability Engineering, and Continuous Improvement frameworks across global operations.
  • Lead globally distributed teams, managing managers, senior engineering leads, product capability teams, automation teams, and vendors across service management, AI-led engineering, and enterprise service modernization.
  • Drive teams in an agile, product-oriented, and outcome-focused way of working, ensuring clear priorities, measurable business outcomes, disciplined execution, and continuous delivery of value.
  • Establish and govern CSL/SLA KPI structures performance dashboards, benchmarking, SLA/XLA tracking, engineering productivity metrics, service reliability metrics, and KPI Tree frameworks that connect operational performance to business value drivers.
  • Drive service modernization by partnering with platform and technology teams to harmonize fragmented service management capabilities, improve integration maturity, simplify workflows, and enable scalable, API-first and event-driven service experiences.
  • Build and scale ITSM product capabilities, workflow automation, service orchestration, and integration-led services as part of an AI-first operating model, including AIOps, conversational AI, chat/voice automation, Agentic AI, and intelligent workflow engineering to drive ticket deflection, ticket elimination, faster resolution, and productivity gains.
  • Lead engineering-led service reliability improvements by embedding automation, observability, telemetry, root cause intelligence, proactive detection, and self-healing patterns into the service management ecosystem.
  • Drive product and engineering practices across ITSM capabilities, including reusable integrations, automation frameworks, workflow standards, agile backlog management, release governance, prioritization, sprint planning, and scalable capability delivery.
  • Lead multi-vendor governance, including OrchestratorOperator models, across global functions, ensuring engineering accountability, delivery quality, cost-efficiency, standardization, and centralization opportunities.
  • Drive cost-of-service optimization through automation, digitalization, product simplification, productivity engineering, and operating model simplification.
  • Champion organizational change management, engineering capability building, AI adoption, agile maturity, and a performance-oriented, customer-led culture across global teams.
Qualifications
  • 16+ years of progressive IT/technology leadership experience, including direct experience leading large team, globally distributed organizations and managing managers/senior leads.
  • Proven track record of enterprise ITSM/Service Management transformation in regulated, large-scale environments (FMGC or comparable enterprise settings).
  • Deep expertise in ServiceNow strategy, ITIL processes, and multi-tool platform harmonization/consolidation.
  • Demonstrated success building AIOps, ServiceNow integration and automation of services, and conversational AI/chatbot capabilities that measurably reduce MTTR, ticket volume, and manual effort.
  • Strong governance experience: KPI/SLA/XLA frameworks, vendor governance, service catalogue management, and audit/compliance readiness.
  • Experience owning multi-million-dollar budgets and driving cost-of-service optimization at enterprise scale.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging senior leadership, Global Process Owners, and multi-vendor ecosystems.
  • Bachelor''s degree in Engineering or related field; advanced management education (MBA) preferred.

Vanguards India Office
Vanguards office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
Role Summary
This role provides expert-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases, and directs business assessment and requirements analysis for hardware and operating systems, while architecting complex data integration and driving system performance and scalability improvements.
Responsibilities:
  • Collaborate closely with business users, product managers, and engineering partners - actively asking questions and clarifying requirements to ensure high-quality outcomes.
  • Design and implement Python-based microservices on AWS, using event-driven patterns tied to S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, Step Functions, and ECS.
  • Demonstrate expert-level ownership of data architecture, including, S3 buckets and Access Points, Bucket/object modelling and partitioning, DynamoDB and NoSQL data modelling, REST / GraphQL APIs, Encryption/KMS policies, High-throughput performance considerations
  • Integrate S3 and DynamoDB with event-driven compute (Lambda), orchestrated workflows (Step Functions), and container workloads (ECS).
  • Define and execute end-to-end testing strategies for event-driven systems, including contract testing, schema validation, replay/idempotency testing, and integration scenarios across multiple AWS services.
  • Work with Avro for data serialization, including schema design and evolution, compatibility rules, and performance optimization using Python libraries such as fastavro or avro.
  • Maintain engineering excellence through clean architecture, code reviews, robust documentation, observability and resilience practices, and operational readiness.
  • Provide 3rd-line support as needed and contribute to continuous improvement.
Qualifications and Skills
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in application development, system architecture and database management.
  • Bachelors degree (B.E./B.Tech) or Masters degree (M.E./M.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Expert-level Python development, including:
    • Object-oriented programming
    • Type hints and static analysis
    • Packaging, virtual environments, and dependency management
    • Concurrency (multiprocessing)
    • Deep testing experience using pytest, unittest, and related frameworks

Youll also lead our Centers of Excellence (CoE) initiative, building the internal expert and facilitator communities that let Innovaccer teach and scale its own expertise. Program Design, Delivery & Vendor Management

Sr. AI/ML Engineer

Bangalore

Job Summary

We seek highly dedicated, motivated, and passionate Sr. AI/ML Engineers who can use the right tools to find the best solutions to problems. We embrace the Agile methodology and as part of a scrum team you will play an important role in all aspects of product development--design, development, integration, and testing. And you will share in the pride and satisfaction as your work makes it into production at INVIDI s clients.

As a Sr. AI/ML Engineer to own the computer vision and visual search platform that powers our mobile and cloud applications. Youll work across the full machine learning lifecycle, from data collection and model training to production deployment and performance optimization, building AI systems that operate reliably in real-world conditions. Youll have the opportunity to improve existing models, introduce new approaches, and help define the future AI architecture of our platform. This is a hands-on engineering role where youll collaborate closely with mobile, backend, and product teams to deliver production-grade AI experiences.

Key Responsibilities

Build and Improve Production AI Models

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy state-of-the-art computer vision models for object detection, image understanding, and visual search.
  • Improve model robustness across challenging real-world scenarios including varying lighting conditions, perspective changes, motion blur, occlusion, compression artifacts, and partial captures.
  • Continuously evaluate and iterate on models using production feedback and newly collected data.

Optimize AI for Mobile and Cloud

  • Optimize inference performance for both edge and cloud deployments, balancing accuracy, latency, memory usage, and operational cost.
  • Improve mobile ML performance across iOS and Android while accounting for device constraints such as thermal throttling, battery usage, and hardware acceleration.
  • Build scalable cloud inference services capable of supporting high-volume production workloads.

Build a World-Class ML Platform

  • Design reproducible training pipelines, model versioning strategies, and automated evaluation workflows.
  • Establish quality gates and validation processes to ensure models meet production standards before deployment.
  • Improve CI/CD pipelines, artifact management, and promotion workflows across development, staging, and production environments.

Own Data Quality and Evaluation

  • Develop data collection strategies that improve model performance and generalization.
  • Create synthetic and augmented datasets to increase robustness across diverse operating conditions.
  • Build automated benchmarking and evaluation pipelines with measurable performance metrics and regression testing.

Improve Visual Search and Retrieval

  • Design and optimize image embedding and similarity search pipelines.
  • Improve semantic matching, reranking, and retrieval quality for image-based search experiences.
  • Evaluate new architectures and techniques that enhance accuracy and user experience.

Collaborate Across Engineering Teams

  • Work closely with mobile and backend engineers to integrate AI models into production applications.
  • Debug end-to-end ML systems, from training pipelines and inference services to client-side image preprocessing and post-processing.
  • Contribute to technical architecture decisions and establish best practices for scalable AI development.

Drive Innovation

  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to improve existing capabilities.
  • Prototype new features in computer vision, multimodal AI, recommendation systems, and conversational AI.
  • Help shape the long-term AI strategy and technical roadmap.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building and deploying production machine learning systems.
  • Strong expertise in computer vision, including object detection, image understanding, and visual embeddings.
  • Experience training, fine-tuning, evaluating, and deploying deep learning models using real-world datasets.
  • Hands-on experience with modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Experience optimizing models for both cloud and edge/mobile deployment.
  • Strong understanding of vector search, similarity retrieval, and embedding-based systems.
  • Experience building scalable ML pipelines, model evaluation frameworks, and production inference services.
  • Excellent Python development skills and the ability to work across multiple parts of the technology stack.
  • Strong experience with AWS cloud services, including designing and deploying ML solutions using SageMaker, Lambda, S3 and related services.

It would be very good if you have experience in:

  • Experience with MLOps, model registries, automated training pipelines, and CI/CD for machine learning.
  • Experience deploying AI applications on AWS or similar cloud platforms.
  • Familiarity with mobile machine learning frameworks and optimization techniques.
  • Background in content recognition, recommendation systems, visual search, AdTech, media, or consumer applications.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar).

Physical requirements

  • INVIDI is a conscious, clean, well-organized, and supportive office.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer are normal.

Red Nucleus is hiring a Agile Project Manager - iTakeControl to join our global team. This role will be fully onsite at our Pune office. There may be flexibility to transition to a hybrid work model in the future, based on business requirements.


Our purpose is advancing knowledge to improve lives. We succeed by being the premier provider of strategic learning and development, scientific advisory services, and medical communications solutions for the life sciences industry. Our global team is composed of nearly 800 full-time employees whose commitment to creativity, quality, and on-time delivery is unrivaled in our space.


At Red Nucleus, we believe in providing a rich working environment that pushes us to innovate in ways that engages our employees to be their best selves. Our culture is about meaningful work, a true sense of community, and fun. We love to celebrate our people and we are proud to have been Internationally recognized as a Great Place to Work".


How You Will Contribute

In this position, you will be working with our Clinical Research team. For more information, please visit ITC I Red Nucleus.

Job Overview

iTakeControl is a clinical trial platform supporting live studies within a validated, GxP-compliant environment. We are bringing the platform fully in-house and building the team that will own and grow it.


We are looking for an experienced Agile Project Manager to own delivery and be the bridge between the business and the engineering team. You will balance two priorities: coordinating the delivery of the platform to clients including configuring and launching new clinical studies and driving the ongoing development of the product. The immediate focus is keeping client delivery running smoothly; as that settles into a steady cadence, the role grows to take on more of the process governance-Agile principles, Scrum practices, and continuous improvement.


This is a delivery-accountable role for someone who can translate between business and technical teams, keep priorities clear, and make sure the right work ships at the right time. It works closely with US-based stakeholders and requires daily overlap with US hours.

What Youll Own

  • Client delivery own the end-to-end delivery and configuration of the platform for clients, getting new studies live and supported on time and within compliance
  • Product delivery own the teams delivery rhythm: prioritization, planning, and release coordination for the core platform in collaboration with the Product management team
  • The bridge intake the feature requirements, enhancement requests from product team and create the realistic development plan in collaboration with the engineering team, and keep both sides aligned on what comes first and why
  • Priority calls make and communicate the trade-offs when client delivery and product work compete for the same people
  • Delivery health track and report progress using meaningful flow metrics, and surface risks early with options
  • Process efficiency - As the engineering team matures, build efficiency KPIs for teams delivery and quality performance.

You will partner closely with the Technical Lead, who owns technical direction; this role owns coordination and delivery.


What Were Looking For

Experience and Mindset

  • 7+ years managing software delivery, with a strong track record of shipping on time
  • Proven experience owning client-facing delivery or implementation not only internal product work
  • Strong agile background, with the judgement to choose and adapt the right approach for the team rather than applying one framework by rote (we are not tied to a single methodology)
  • Comfortable managing multiple concurrent priorities and competing deadlines
  • A natural translator between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders, who can negotiate realistic plans between the two
  • Strong ownership instincts accountable for outcomes, not just facilitation
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills builds trust quickly across clients, leadership, and the engineering team, and keeps everyone informed and aligned
  • Stays composed under pressure keeps a clear head and a steady hand when priorities collide, deadlines tighten, or issues escalate, and brings the team along calmly
  • Clear, honest communicator who brings problems forward early

Clinical and Regulatory

  • Life sciences background is essential experience delivering software in clinical trials, healthcare IT, pharma, medical devices, or an equivalent regulated environment
  • Understanding of what it means to deliver within a validated, GxP-compliant system change control, data integrity, and the discipline a regulated environment demands

Technical Fluency

  • Enough technical fluency to coordinate engineering work credibly understand dependencies, ask the right questions, and challenge estimates (you do not need to write code)
  • Comfortable with standard delivery and collaboration tooling, and open to AI-assisted tools that speed up planning and reporting

Education and Experience



  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences, or a related field
  • 7+ years in software project / delivery management, including client-facing delivery and/or Scrum Master roles
  • 3+ years leading delivery for an engineering team
  • 3+ years within regulated or validated software environments (clinical, GxP, FDA, HIPAA, or equivalent)
  • Strong understanding of Agile frameworks including Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe.
  • Agile and/or project management certification (CSM, PSM, PMI-ACP, SAFe, PMP, or equivalent) a plus
  • Experience in enterprise Agile transformation initiatives.
  • Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI/CD processes.
  • Direct experience with a clinical trial / patient engagement / eCOA platform preferred

  • Generous paid time off, employee assistance programs and flexible work arrangements
  • Performance driven environment including professional development and transfer opportunities

India remote

Impact the world of technology by pushing the boundaries of technology and business models, working at MariaDB, plc. Be part of a game-changing organization that encourages outside-the-box thinking, values empowerment, and is truly shaping the future of the software industry.

We are looking for an AI Architect to own the technical design and delivery of our AI platform. Architecture & Design

  • Work with multimodal models (vision-language) where they simplify or outperform traditional CV pipelines.

  • Own cost architecture: instance/accelerator selection, spot strategy, autoscaling, caching, and token-spend controls.
  • Implement CI/CD for models (MLOps): automated retraining, model registry, canary and blue-green rollouts, drift detection, and rollback.
  • Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and data-residency requirements in partnership with the security team.

Leadership

  • Communicate technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and executives.

title: Technical Lead
jobDescription:
Job Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Technical Lead to own the technical design and delivery of client-facing and internal modules across .NET, modern JavaScript frontends, and cloud. You will turn functional requirements into designs that are secure, scalable, and maintainable and then build a substantial part of them yourself.

This is a coding role first and a leadership role second. Expect to spend the majority of your time in the codebase: writing the hard parts, reviewing pull requests, unblocking your team, and holding the quality line. You will work closely with the Solution Architect and delivery leadership on the wider architecture, and you will be the person who makes sure it actually lands in production the way it was designed.

You will also be hands-on in how we adopt AI/ML and LLM-based capabilities across our delivery portfolio.


Key Responsibilities


Technical Design & Delivery

  • Own the technical design of assigned modules and applications application logic, integration points, data model, and deployment approach.
  • Translate functional requirements and user stories into technical designs, sequence diagrams, API contracts, and data models.
  • Contribute to solution-level architecture decisions and document trade-offs for the options considered and rejected.
  • Break down features into tasks, estimate effort realistically, and drive them to completion within sprint commitments.
  • Design with non-functional requirements in mind from the start: performance, scalability, security, observability, and cost.
  • Execute staged modernisation of legacy applications (e.g., .NET Framework / .NET Core current LTS) under an agreed migration plan.
  • Apply and enforce engineering standards: coding guidelines, branching strategy, code review expectations, test coverage, and definition of done.

Hands-On Engineering

  • Write production code for the complex, high-risk, or performance-critical parts of the system.
  • Build proofs of concept, reference implementations, and reusable components for the team.
  • Review pull requests with substance correctness, security, performance, and readability, not just style.
  • Diagnose production issues: performance bottlenecks, memory pressure, N+1 queries, cache behaviour, and concurrency problems.
  • Keep CI/CD, automated testing, and quality gates working and taken seriously by the team.

Cloud & Platform

  • Build and operate solutions on Azure or AWS compute, storage, networking, identity, and secrets management.
  • Implement containerisation and deployment pipelines where appropriate (Docker, and Kubernetes/AKS/EKS where in use).
  • Instrument applications for observability logging, metrics, tracing, alerting and act on what they show.
  • Flag cost implications of design choices and implement agreed optimisations.

AI/ML & LLM Solutions

  • Build LLM-backed features: RAG pipelines, chunking and embedding strategy, vector store integration, retrieval quality, and prompt and context design.
  • Understand the practical trade-offs between prompt engineering, RAG, and fine-tuning, and pick sensibly for the problem at hand.
  • Handle the real constraints of LLM systems: latency, token cost, rate limits, caching, fallback behaviour, and graceful degradation.
  • Implement evaluation and guardrails groundedness checks, hallucination mitigation, PII handling, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
  • Have an informed view on where AI/ML genuinely adds value and where it does not.
  • Work with data engineering on the pipelines and data quality these features depend on.

Team Leadership & Mentoring

  • Lead a team of 38 engineers day to day: task allocation, standups, unblocking, and progress visibility.
  • Mentor mid-level and junior engineers through code review, pairing, and design discussions.
  • Own the technical quality of what your team ships, including defect triage and release readiness.
  • Support technical hiring interviewing and candidate evaluation.
  • Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, tech talks, and reusable IP.

Client & Delivery Support

  • Join technical discussions and requirement clarification sessions with clients where needed.
  • Provide effort estimates and technical inputs for proposals and solution approach documents.
  • Explain technical decisions and trade-offs clearly to project managers, clients, and stakeholders.

Required Skills


Must Have Depth Expected

  • 69 years in software engineering, with production systems you have personally built and shipped.
  • Strong .NET / C# ASP.NET Core, Web API, Entity Framework Core, async programming, dependency injection, and current LTS versions.
  • Solid working experience with one cloud platform Azure or AWS. Azure preferred (App Service, Functions, Azure SQL / PostgreSQL, Service Bus, Key Vault, Entra ID, Application Insights). AWS equivalents equally acceptable.
  • At least one modern frontend framework in depth Angular or React plus TypeScript. Working familiarity with the other is a plus.
  • Node.js for services, tooling, or BFF layers.
  • Databases: strong SQL (SQL Server / PostgreSQL), data modelling, indexing, and query tuning. Awareness of NoSQL and when it fits.
  • Design and architectural patterns: REST API design, layered/clean architecture, messaging and queues, caching strategies, and a working understanding of microservices and event-driven design including when a monolith is the better answer.
  • Security fundamentals: OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, RBAC, secrets management, OWASP Top 10.
  • DevOps: Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, Git branching strategies, Docker.

Must Have Working Understanding

  • Practical understanding of AI/ML concepts and the ML lifecycle.
  • Hands-on exposure to LLM-based application development RAG, embeddings, vector databases (pgvector, Azure AI Search, Pinecone, or similar), and orchestration frameworks (LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with major model providers and the trade-offs between hosted APIs and self-hosted/open models.
  • Python for AI/ML, scripting, and data work.
  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code (Bicep/ARM/Terraform).

Non-Technical

  • Clear written communication your design notes and PR comments matter as much as your code.
  • Ability to explain a technical trade-off to a project manager and to a junior engineer, on the same day, without changing your answer.
  • Comfortable being challenged and equally comfortable changing your mind when the argument is better.
  • Ownership: you follow a decision through to production, not to the end of the design phase.

Qualification

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Master's is a plus.
  • Equivalent demonstrable experience will be considered in place of formal qualifications.

Preferred (Added Advantage)

  • Cloud certification Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204), Azure Administrator (AZ-104), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or the AWS equivalents.
  • Experience in an IT services or consulting environment with multiple concurrent clients.
  • Exposure to data engineering and analytics Azure Synapse, Databricks, PySpark, dbt, Power BI.
  • Experience running containerised workloads in production.
  • Experience shipping an AI/LLM feature to production, including how it was evaluated.
  • Open-source contributions, technical writing, or conference speaking.

What Success Looks Like in This Role


First 90 days

  • Productive in the codebase and reviewing pull requests independently.
  • Understood the module landscape you own and identified its top technical risks with evidence.
  • Delivered at least one design document and one feature shipped end to end.

First 6–12 months

  • Engineering standards consistently followed by your team, with review and test discipline visibly improved.
  • Measurable improvement in delivery predictability, defect escape rate, or system performance.
  • At least one AI/LLM capability built, evaluated, and delivered to production or a credible pilot.
  • One or more engineers visibly levelled up under your mentorship.

What We Offer

  • Real ownership of the technical design and delivery of the systems you work on.
  • Direct access to leadership and a short path from decision to implementation.
  • Room to grow into a Solution Architect role, with the support to get there.
  • Hands-on work on modern cloud and AI engineering, not maintenance.
  • Sponsorship for certifications and continuous learning.
  • A collaborative, engineering-led environment.

How to Apply

Share your CV at [careers email] with the subject line "Application – Technical Lead – Pune". Include a brief note on one technical decision you made that turned out to be wrong, and what you did about it.

ML and AI Solution Ownership

  • Real-time bid-response prediction

  • Campaign pacing and delivery optimisation
  • Inventory, demand, impression, and revenue forecasting
  • Audience modelling and lookalike generation
  • Supply-path and traffic-quality optimisation
  • Invalid-traffic and anomaly detection
  • Creative intelligence and contextual classification
  • Recommendation and ranking systems
  • Automated campaign planning and optimisation

Production ML Engineering

Design scalable training, feature-engineering, model-serving, and monitoring architectures.

Develop batch, streaming, and low-latency inference systems.

Establish standards for model versioning, reproducibility, deployment, rollback, observability, and governance.

Ensure ML services meet production expectations for latency, throughput, availability, accuracy, and cost.

Work with platform engineers to integrate models into real-time ad-serving and decision- making workflows.

Design systems that combine traditional ML, optimisation algorithms, and business rules where appropriate.

Define offline and online evaluation frameworks for ML initiatives.

Design A/B tests, holdout experiments, and incremental-impact measurement.

Connect model metrics with business outcomes such as:

  • Win rate
  • Response rate
  • Fill rate
  • Revenue
  • Publisher yield
  • Advertiser ROI
  • Campaign delivery
  • Margin
  • Forecast accuracy

Build AI capabilities for campaign planning, analytics, reporting, inventory discovery, engineering productivity, and operational automation.

Evaluate models and frameworks based on accuracy, latency, cost, privacy, reliability, and maintainability.

Establish guardrails, evaluation datasets, human-approval workflows, and monitoring for AI-generated outputs.

Identify where deterministic systems or traditional ML are more appropriate than Generative AI.

jobDescription:
Responsibilities:
Deep Learning Model Conversion: Convert and adapt deep learning network architectures (e.g., from PyTorch) for deployment on various embedded platforms.
Quantization-Aware Training (QAT): Implement and fine-tune Quantization-Aware Training techniques to optimize model performance and reduce memory footprint while maintaining accuracy.
Model Optimization: Perform extensive model optimization techniques, including pruning, quantization (post-training and QAT), and network architecture search, to achieve desired latency, power, and memory targets.
Runtime Integration: Integrate optimized deep learning models with embedded runtime environments and hardware accelerators.

Number Format Conversion: Work with various number formats (e.g., FP32, FP16, INT8) and develop strategies for efficient conversion and utilization on embedded processors.
Toolchain Development & Utilization: Utilize and contribute to the development of custom conversion tools and optimization scripts to streamline the deployment pipeline.

Experience: 5+ years of experience in embedded software development with a strong focus on AI/Machine Learning deployment.
Programming Skills: Proficient in Python for AI development and scripting.
Deep Learning Frameworks: Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch. Experience with TensorFlow/Keras is a plus.
Embedded Systems: Strong understanding of embedded system architectures, microcontrollers, DSPs, and/or FPGAs.
Optimization Techniques: Proven experience with deep learning model optimization techniques (quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation).

Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a strong ability to debug and optimize complex systems.
Experience with C/C++ for embedded development.
Familiarity with hardware acceleration (e.g., NPUs, GPUs on edge devices).

Job title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer
Experience : 6+ Years
Location : Pune/Banglore
Work Mode : Remote
Notice Period: Immediate

The Opportunity
This is a role in a new AI engineering squad. You'll work across the full agentic stack from designing agent architectures and RAG pipelines to shipping autonomous agents that replace manual processes in production. Hands-on, delivery-focused, and consequential from day one.

What You'll Do
Agents
• Design and build multi-agent systems for autonomous reasoning, planning, and task execution
• Architect orchestration patterns; tool use, memory, reflection loops, human-in-the-loop handoffs
• Deliver across use cases: developer productivity agents, knowledge retrieval agents, and process
automation
• Favour GCP-native and enterprise-grade managed services before writing custom infrastructure, we're
not in the business of rebuilding what a major cloud vendor will productise in six months
RAG, Knowledge & Graph
• Design and implement end-to-end RAG architectures ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval,
reranking
• Select and manage vector databases appropriate to the use case
• Build knowledge pipelines that turn unstructured client data into queryable intelligence
• Apply knowledge graph structures (e.g. Neo4j) where relational or semantic reasoning adds value
beyond flat vector retrieval
Evaluation & Observability
• Design and own eval frameworks; automated evals, LLM-as-a-Judge, task-completion harnesses
• Define what 'working correctly' looks like for each agent and measure it continuously in production
• Instrument agents for cost, latency, and quality
Platform & Collaboration
• Contribute to platform standards how agents are built, deployed, monitored, and governed
• Ensure agents are production-grade: observable, cost-aware, GDPR and EU AI Act compliant
• Work with engineering, business stakeholders, and the Director of Platform, Engineering & AI to
translate process problems into agentic solutions
What We're Looking For
Must-Have
• Production experience building and deploying agentic AI systems not just prototypes
• Strong Python engineering: clean, tested, maintainable code
• Hands-on RAG pipeline design chunking strategies, embedding models, retrieval, evaluation
• Production experience with at least one vector database
• LLM evaluation experience automated evals, LLM-as-a-Judge, or equivalent agent accuracy
measurement
• Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar) and the
judgement to know when not to use them
• Solid LLM fundamentals: prompting, tool calling, structured outputs, context management
• Cloud infrastructure comfort GCP preferred; strong AWS/Azure considered
Nice-to-Have
• Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or Vertex AI Agent Builder
• MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agent-to-agent communication patterns
• Knowledge graphs or graph databases (Neo4j, JanusGraph) in retrieval or reasoning contexts
• LLMOps / observability tooling LangSmith, Langfuse, or equivalent
• Experience building agents in regulated or enterprise environments
• Background in BPO, AP automation, or document processing workflows
What Good Looks Like
• Shipped agents, not demos production deployment matters more than framework familiarity
• Engineering mindset you care about reliability, cost, testability, and observability
• Built evals, not vibes you measure whether agents work and instrument from day one
• Build-vs-buy judgment you reach for GCP-native and enterprise tooling before writing custom
infrastructure you've seen bespoke orchestration layers made redundant by a platform release, and
you build accordingly
• Comfortable with ambiguity you help define the patterns rather than follow them
• Business curious you want to understand the process you're automating, not just the stack
A Note on This Role
Agentic AI engineering is genuinely new. We don't expect 10 years of experience in a discipline that's 2 years
old. What we do expect is evidence of building real things, strong software engineering foundations, and the
intellectual curiosity to stay ahead of a fast-moving field. If you've been doing this seriously for 18 months and
have production systems to show for it, we want to hear from you.

descriptionFromApi:
Product Manager - Hevo

The Hard Thing About Data

Most companies that claim to have a "data platform" have a dashboard with some charts and a dream. Hevo has something different. Something that took eight years to build and cant be bought. Over 2,000 companies send us their most sensitive data every single day. 100 billion events a month. Raw. Unfiltered. Before transformation, before aggregation, at the exact moment truth is created. Thats not a product feature. Thats trust, earned one customer at a time, over eight years, by not screwing up.

That position is now the foundation for something much bigger. Were building an Intelligence Layer on top of it, a system that reads across every data source a company runs, connects the signals that matter, and tells people what to do before they have to go looking for answers. We call it the Context Graph. Its real enough to show results. Early enough that the person who joins now defines what it becomes.

This is the moment. Not the moment after its obvious. Now.

What Youre Walking Into

Youll own a product pod. SaaS integrations, database connectors, or the Intelligence Layer, depending on where the biggest need is when you join. You own the backlog. More importantly, you own the why behind everything that gets built. You report directly to the CEO. In the first 3-6 months, your job is to make the foundation bulletproof, find the gaps in the platform, close them, and make the product sharper than its ever been. After that, you move into the Intelligence Layer and help define what Hevo becomes in its next chapter.

What This Job Actually Is

Lets be honest about what great PMs do, and what mediocre ones do instead. Mediocre PMs write specs and hand them off. They synthesize feedback from CSMs and call it customer insight. They sit in architecture meetings and nod. They measure their own output in documents shipped, not outcomes delivered. Thats not this job. This job is three things, done well, simultneously.

First: technical ownership. You will be in the room when architecture decisions get made. Not watching. Contributing. Pushing back. Asking the questions that change the direction of the decision. You need to understand how data pipelines work at a systems level, CDC, connectors, streaming, schema management, failure modes. If you cant hold your own in that room, engineering will stop inviting you to it. And theyll be right to.

Second: direct customer engagement. You talk to customers yourself. No intermediary. No secondhand summary. You hear the problem in the customers own words, you sit with the complexity of it, and you own the translation into product decisions. If youre relying on a CSM to tell you what customers need, you will always be one step behind.

Third: making complexity simple. Hevos product is deeply technical. The people who sell it and support it are not always. A big part of your job is taking complex system behavior and making it crisp and understandable, for Support, for CS, for Solutions Engineering, so they can represent the product confidently to customers. If internal teams are confused, customers will be too.

Who Were Looking For

6-8 years of product experience. Meaningful time on platform or infrastructure products at B2B companies. Not optional.
Strong technical depth. CS degree or equivalent engineering background. You should be able to hold a real conversation about system design, data architecture, API design, and engineering tradeoffs, not a surface level one.
Proven ability to engage directly with customers. Not customer research. Not user interviews handed to you by a researcher. Direct engagement, gathering requirements, presenting product direction, handling objections in real time.
Clear, structured communication. Written and verbal. You can make a complex system understandable to a non-technical audience without sacrificing accuracy. This is rarer than it sounds.
High ownership. You dont wait for conditions to be perfect. You move. You iterate. You follow through. When you say youll do something, it gets done.
Nice to have: Engineer-turned-PM. Experience at a Series A-C company where you had to balance speed with quality. Familiarity with the data integration and pipeline landscape.

What Good Looks Like in Year One

After 12 months, a great hire will have:
Full, unambiguous ownership of their pods backlog, with a defensible point of view on priorities thats grounded in customer reality and business impact.
Identified and closed the most critical gaps in their product area, with improvements that customers and internal teams can actually feel.
Built enough technical depth to shape architecture decisions, not observe them.
Become the person in the company most connected to what customers actually need from their product area.
Made internal teams measurably better at representing the product.
Started actively shaping the Intelligence Layer, contributing product thinking and customer insight as Hevo moves into its next chapter.

The Moment

Hevo spent eight years building both a product and a business simultaneously, and the foundation is real.
The Intelligence Layer is early. The window to define what it becomes is open right now. Most people will look at this moment in five years and wish theyd been here for it.

If youre one of the people who wants to be here for it, lets talk.

  • Work on projects executed across geographies and cultures.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior developers.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver solutions.
  • Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.
  • Expected to be an SME.
  • Collaborate and manage the team to perform.
  • Responsible for team decisions.
  • Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
  • Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
  • Mentor junior team members to enhance their skills and knowledge.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve development processes to increase efficiency.

    Professional & Technical Skills:Extensive experience in developing S4HANA ABAP CDS Views.
  • Strong knowledge of SAP Fiori Apps, particularly Analytic apps
  • Proficiency in extending standard Fiori Analytic apps and CDS Views
  • Excellent communication skills and comfortable working directly with customers.
  • Experience in requirement gathering, technical analysis, and problem-solving.
  • Ability to work as a member of a global team with a high degree of working hour flexibility.
  • Must Have Skills:Proficiency in SAP Native HANA SQL Modeling & Development.
  • Strong understanding of database design principles and data modeling techniques.
  • Experience with performance tuning and optimization of SQL queries.
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies and modern software development practices.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and communicate effectively.

    Additional Information:
  • Knowledge of SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)
  • Familiarity with SAP Datasphere and SAP BTP applications.
  • SAP Certified Associate - SAP Generative AI Developer (preferred).
  • Bachelor''s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • The candidate should have minimum 7.5 years of experience in SAP Native HANA SQL Modeling & Development.
  • This position is based at our Pune office.
  • A 15 years full time education is required.

    Qualification

Job Summary
The Manager, GTM Sales Enablement owns the scope and execution of Shield AI's recurring enablement engine for the Go-to-Market organization. The role exists to make sellers measurably more productive every quarter, through two connected programs: the Quarterly Enablement Bootcamps that bring the field together to build skill and alignment, and the Quarterly Enablement Plans that keep tenured sellers sharp against a changing market, product set, competitive landscape, deal qualification and sales best practices.
This is a building and running role. The work product is delivered programs: bootcamp curricula, facilitator-ready content, learning paths, readiness assessments, and the cadence that keeps the whole system on schedule. Where the GTM Strategy function defines what the GTM organization needs to know and why, this role decides how it gets taught, who delivers it, and how readiness is proven.
The constant is the discipline: a quarterly rhythm that ships on time, content that holds up to the field, and enablement that moves seller behavior rather than filling a calendar.
What this role owns
  • Quarterly Enablement Bootcamp ownership . Own end to end scope, design, and execution of the quarterly bootcamps. Set the agenda, build the run of show, secure facilitators and subject matter experts, prepare all content and materials, manage logistics, and run the event. Each bootcamp ships on a fixed quarterly cadence with clear outcomes and a readiness bar that participants must clear.
  • Quarterly Enablement Plans (QEP) for tenured sellers. Design and run the quarterly plan that keeps experienced sellers current. Translate new products, plays, competitive moves, and pricing changes into focused learning that fits a working sellers calendar. Differentiate the plan by role and tenure so the content lands for BDMs, Territory Managers, Hivemind Specialists, FSEs, and capture leads at the right depth.
  • Topic definition with GTM Strategy. Partner closely with Scott Powers, who leads GTM Strategy, to define the topics each quarters enablement must cover. Strategy sets the priorities, the market evidence, and the plays that need to land in the field; this role converts those priorities into a teachable curriculum and a delivery plan with named owners and dates.
  • Content build and systemization. Build and maintain the enablement content library, certifications, and learning paths. Turn one-off material into reusable, versioned assets that scale across cohorts and quarters. Keep content current as products, competitors, and the buying environment shift.
  • Facilitation and delivery network. Recruit, prepare, and coach the internal facilitators, sales leaders, and SMEs who deliver enablement. Build a bench so the program does not depend on any single presenter, and hold a consistent quality bar across every session.
  • Readiness measurement. Define and track the metrics that prove enablement is working: participation, certification and assessment results, manager-observed behavior change, and downstream indicators tied to ramp and deal execution. Report results each quarter and feed them back into the next plan.
Current Priorities (FY27)
The agenda below reflects todays top priorities. Expect it to evolve as the business does.
  • Quarterly Bootcamp cadence. Lock a repeatable quarterly bootcamp model with a fixed run of show, a clear outcome set, and a readiness bar every cohort clears. Build the operating calendar twelve months out so the field and facilitators can plan against it.
  • Tenured Seller Enablement Plan. Stand up the quarterly plan for experienced sellers, differentiated by role and tenure. Convert each quarters product, competitive, and pricing changes into focused, calendar-friendly learning that keeps the existing field current without pulling them off the number.
  • Topic intake with GTM Strategy. Build the quarterly intake rhythm with GTM Strategy so topics are set early, sequenced against capacity, and tied to the plays and evidence that matter most that quarter.
  • Content systemization. Convert existing enablement material into a versioned, reusable library with certifications and role-based learning paths, so each quarter builds on the last rather than starting over.
  • Sales Kickoff support. Build and deliver the enablement content and certification track that anchors the annual Sales Kickoff, in partnership with GTM Strategy on narrative and outcomes.
How the role operates
  • Field-first posture. Build enablement from how sellers actually work. Sit in on calls, ride along on deals, talk to managers, and pressure-test every program against the reality of the field before it ships. Enablement that does not survive contact with a working seller does not ship.
  • Quarterly operating rhythm. Run on a disciplined quarterly cadence: intake topics with GTM Strategy, design and build the content, deliver the bootcamp and tenured plan, measure readiness, then feed results into the next cycle. The calendar is fixed; the content adapts.
  • Decision rights. The role owns the design and execution of the enablement programs and the readiness bar. GTM Strategy owns the topic priorities and the supporting evidence. Sales leadership owns reinforcement in the field and the results that follow.
  • Authority model. Influence through program quality, a reliable cadence, and readiness results. Earn the fields time by making every session worth it, and earn leaderships trust by proving behavior change.
  • Output. Bootcamp curricula and run-of-show, facilitator-ready content, role-based learning paths and certifications, quarterly tenured-seller plans, readiness assessments, and the quarterly readiness report.
  • Stays current in real time. Tracks product changes, competitive moves, and industry trends as they happen, and adjusts enablement plans on the fly so the team gets what it needs today, not next quarter.

title: CICS Systems Programmer
jobDescription:
The Role

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you'll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You'll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients - which means some of the biggest in the world.

There's never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You'll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You'll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients.

Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, and maintain CICS environments.
  • Manage CICSplex infrastructure.
  • Support transaction processing environments.
  • Troubleshoot availability and performance issues.
  • Support upgrades and migrations.
  • Ensure resiliency and disaster recovery readiness.
  • Integrate CICS with DB2, MQ, RACF, and z/OS services.

Who You Are

You're good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important - you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused - someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you're open and borderless - naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Strong experience in IBM CICS Transaction Server (CICS TS) administration, including CICSPlex SM, CICS region management, and transaction processing.
  • Expertise in CICS performance tuning, recovery management, diagnostics, dump analysis, and problem determination.
  • Experience integrating CICS with IBM MQ, DB2, RACF, and z/OS subsystems.
  • Knowledge of high-availability, workload management, and mission-critical transaction processing environments.
  • Experience with Microsoft Windows Server 2016/2019, VMware ESX, and public/private cloud environments, including on-premises to cloud migrations.

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience

  • Experience with CICSPlex SM, CICS upgrades, migrations, maintenance, and release management.
  • Knowledge of OMEGAMON for CICS, CICS Explorer, JCL, SMP/E, and REXX.
  • Familiarity with Parallel Sysplex, workload balancing, disaster recovery, and resilience architectures.
  • Understanding of ITIL Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.
  • Experience with automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), vulnerability management, Active Directory, and ADFS.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Being You

The Kyn in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we're excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That's The Kyndryl Way.

descriptionFromApi:
Senior Data Scientist - Generative AI

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist with hands-on experience in Generative AI (GenAI) to drive innovation through cutting-edge AI/ML solutions. This role involves designing and implementing GenAI models and pipelines that solve business problems and enhance productivity. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions using large language models (LLMs), transformers, and other generative techniques.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and fine-tune Generative AI models using LLMs (e.g., GPT, LLaMA, Claude, PaLM) for tasks like summarization, content generation, question answering, semantic search, etc.
  • Build end-to-end GenAI-powered solutions including prompt engineering, model training/fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment.
  • Use frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate) to build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to identify AI opportunities and prototype solutions.
  • Conduct experiments, evaluate model performance, and optimize for accuracy, latency, and relevance.
  • Contribute to the development of GenAI best practices and reusable assets within the organization.
  • Stay up to date with the latest research and developments in the GenAI and LLM space.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Science or AI roles, with 2+ years in GenAI or LLMs.
  • Strong Python skills and experience with transformers, Hugging Face, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
  • Deep understanding of NLP, language modeling, and generative techniques.
  • Experience with prompt engineering, fine-tuning or few-shot learning.
  • Hands-on experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar GenAI orchestration frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of vector stores, embedding models, and retrieval techniques.
  • Experience with model deployment in cloud or hybrid environments (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and best practices is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Masters or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
  • Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta AI, or Google Cloud GenAI APIs.
  • Background in chatbot development, co-pilot solutions, or enterprise GenAI applications.
  • Publications or contributions to open-source projects in the GenAI space are a plus.

Senior Engineer/Tech Lead - AI & MultiVenture Engineering

A Growing Startup | Pune, India | Full-time



Our Legacy


This startup isnt a shot in the dark its a new wing built on top of a 50-year track record in the electronics trade. A Pune-based distribution company established in 1975 and an authorized distributor for major brands like Nikon, Canon, Panasonic, and Vivo across Maharashtra, and Prime Commerce, a global import/export house for consumer electronics with 7 trading hubs across India and Dubai, serving 17+ countries. This new venture is where that five-decade legacy in electronics trade meets modern technology and you’d be one of the first people building that bridge.


About the Role

We’re a startup building a B2B live trading platform, currently in pre-launch build phase — this hire will have real influence on architecture and product direction from day one. This role isn’t limited to one product — you’ll also take on hands-on technical ownership across a few other ventures we’re building, and coordinate closely with an external partner technology company on shared work.


We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Engineer/Tech Lead with 5+ years of experience building and shipping production software, strong working knowledge of AI/ML integration, and solid command of our tech stack. This is a builder role — you should be comfortable with ambiguity, early-stage pace, and switching context across products. We’re especially looking for someone hands-on and eager to learn, who treats new problems as a chance to grow rather than a distraction.


What You’ll Do

  • Own and build core platform features end-to-end — real-time trading flows, notifications, dashboards, admin panel
  • Take hands-on ownership of features across our other ventures as well — actively building, not just overseeing
  • Act as the primary technical point of contact with our external partner tech company — briefing requirements, reviewing deliverables, keeping cross-team work aligned
  • Design and implement AI-driven features — smart matching, forecasting, fraud/anomaly detection
  • Make key technical decisions on stack, infrastructure, and integrations across the ventures you support
  • Set engineering practices and standards as the team scales; mentor future hires

What We’re Looking For


  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of owning production systems
  • Hands-on proficiency across our stack: Next.js, Tailwind (Web), Flutter (iOS, Android), Python/Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, AWS/GCP
  • Real experience integrating AI/ML (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or similar) into products — not just familiarity with the concepts
  • Comfortable with analytics/reporting tools such as Google Analytics and Clarity
  • Comfort managing multiple projects/companies at once, with high autonomy and low process
  • Experience coordinating with external teams or partner companies on shared deliverables
  • Genuinely hands-on — you’d rather build or fix it yourself than just delegate
  • A real eagerness to learn — this role will stretch across products and domains you may not have touched before

What You’ll Get

A founding-team-level role with real ownership and equity potential

Direct influence over technical direction across multiple ventures

A fast-moving, low-bureaucracy environment with direct access to founders

Job Description

The challenge
Getting an AI to work once is luck; getting it to work a million times is engineering. Any junior with an
API key can write a prompt that looks like magic, but you’ll be here for the "last mile"—when latency
spikes, models hallucinate, and the system collapses under scale. You won't be building another
prototype; you are here to solve coordination problems that don't have StackOverflow answers yet,
turning fragile miracles into boring, reliable infrastructure for a business that demands "autonomous
operations" but has no map to get there.

Why this matters
Mission is Trading for Anyone, Anywhere, Anytime. This scale demands AI that works in production,
not prototypes that demo well.

We're already here: AI resolving 65%+ of customer enquiries, writing and reviewing code, and
processing invoices. We've proved what's possible—now we're scaling it. You will lead the technical
implementation of our next generation of agentic systems, creating co-intelligence that collaborates,
debates, and decides alongside humans.

We're in production, not planning.
400+ users on our internal workflow orchestration platform.
Open-source Spec-to-PR transforming product specs into full implementations.
Real money, real regulations: Our AI handles financial transactions and compliance checks.
You'll join a transformation that's underway, not one waiting for approval.

Architect scalable solutions: You’ll break down ambiguous, function-wide problems into shippable
technical architectures. You won't just solve the immediate bug; you'll design the systems that
prevent it.
Own the outcome: You won’t just build a feature; you’ll ensure it solves the business problem,
monitoring it from deployment through to adoption.
Elevate engineering standards: You’ll review code and design docs not just to catch errors, but to

when to hack a prototype and when to engineer a platform.

You have 7+ years of software engineering experience: At least 3 years building production AI

You’ve shipped production AI: Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that handle real traffic, break in
unexpected ways, and teach you things papers didn't mention.

You think in systems: You see the structural flaws behind the symptoms. You don't just optimize code;
you optimize how the organization solves problems.

Join our India Tech Hub Be among the first hires!


Kobie, a 35-year veteran of the loyalty industry, a multi-year Forrester Leader, and USA Top Workplace is expanding its global footprint by establishing a Tech Hub in India. Kobie partners with global brands to build deep connections with their customers through personalized, data-driven loyalty experiences and has a mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty. The Tech Hub will serve as a Global Capabilities Center for a broad range of technology roles, and this is your chance to play a pivotal role in shaping our presence in India. Join us as we continue to lead in loyalty, delivering innovative customer experiences for some of the world s most recognized brands while working alongside some of the best and brightest in loyalty.

About The Team And What Well Build Together

Kobie runs some of the largest loyalty programs in the world. Were building an internal agent platform on Amazon AgentCore that automates analyst workflows, surfaces insights from program data in Snowflake, and gives our teams an LLM-native way to work with complex loyalty logic.

Were looking for a hands-on Lead AI Engineer to ship the hardest implementation work on that platform. Youll author the per-feature implementation specs that turn architectural decisions into work the team and our code agents can build against. Youll also build the load-bearing pieces yourself the human-in-the-loop routing primitive, the reversibility-tier execution wrapper, the guardrails that make agent actions safe to deploy and review PRs at a depth that lifts the standard for what we ship.

Our team tends to be people who reason carefully, ship working code, and pick up new tools without a lot of hand-holding. We care less about the shape of your career than whether youve built things that held up.

How We Think About AI

Were building agents for an industry loyalty marketing that runs on judgment. The analysts and strategists we serve know things that dont live in any database: which clients can hear which feedback, when a campaign is technically sound but commercially wrong, what a number means versus what it shows. Our agents make their judgment go further; they dont replace it.

That means we have strong views on where agents should and shouldnt act. As Lead, you turn those views into running code: which tools route to a human for approval, which run autonomously, what the refusal policies actually refuse. Were looking for someone with a considered view on cognitive offloading, the long-term effects of agent-mediated work on organizational capacity, and the discipline to build implementation safeguards that augment human judgment rather than supplant it.

How You Will Make An Impact

Spec Authoring Hard Implementation

  • Author per-feature implementation specs (problem framing, approach, module/file map, contracts touched, test plans) at a rigor level code agents and engineers can build against without re-deriving design intent

  • Ship the hardest implementation work yourself the human-in-the-loop routing, the public/private gateway access controls, the early agent harnesses

  • Bring strong design agency: name the implementation tradeoffs, surface gaps in upstream architectural specs, push back when an approach wont hold up in production

Oversight Reliability

  • Design and implement the human-in-the-loop routing system: queue mechanics, reviewer assignment, back-pressure handling, run resumption semantics

  • Implement the execution wrapper that enforces human-in-the-loop polices at execution time

  • Build the safeguards refusal policies, prompt-injection protections, public/private MCP exposure controls that make our agents safe to deploy at scale

Mentorship Review

  • Review PRs (human- and code-agent-authored) at a depth that builds shared judgment about what good agent code looks like

  • Mentor engineers through hard implementation problems; close gaps in the teams shared knowledge

  • Set the standard for what we ship and what we refuse to ship

In Your First 90 Days

By the end of your first 90 days, youll have authored at least two per-feature implementation specs, shipped one load-bearing piece of the platform end-to-end yourself (likely the HITL routing or the execution wrapper), and reviewed enough PRs to have a clear point of view on where our cloud-agent dispatch model is producing good code and where it isnt.

What You Need To Be Successful

  • 6+ years of professional Python with deep production experience operating services, not just shipping them

  • 2+ years operating LLM systems in production: prompt/context engineering, tool/function calling, structured outputs, RAG, evaluation, observability

  • Demonstrated experience implementing oversight mechanisms human-in-the-loop routing, refusal policies, autonomy boundaries in systems where the cost of an agent error is real

  • Strong written communication: youll be authoring implementation specs that other engineers (and code agents) build against, and the spec is the work

  • Extensive knowledge of LangChain/LangGraph or a comparable framework like AgentCore Strands, CrewAI, or Semantic Kernel and a clear view of when to use which

  • Experience with LLM observability tools: Amazon CloudWatch, LangSmith, Langfuse, MLflow, or OpenTelemetry

  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks (RAGAS, DeepEval, LLM-as-judge, multi-turn regression)

  • Solid SQL, fluency with at least one cloud platform (AWS preferred), Git, Docker, and modern API frameworks

  • A hands-on disposition you want to ship the hard parts yourself, not just write specs about them

  • Experience reviewing code authored by junior engineers, contractors, or AI agents and giving feedback that produces better code next time

  • A considered view on the failure modes of overusing AI cognitive offloading, organizational skill loss, agent-mediated drift in decision-making and the conviction to design against them

A bachelors degree is not required. Equivalent practical experience including bootcamps, self-taught work, career changes, or non-CS technical degrees counts.

Nice To Have

  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock and/or AgentCore as a developer: runtime, gateways, memory, policy, guardrails, observability, evaluations, optimizations

  • Experience with Snowflake, Snowpark, or Snowflake Cortex

  • Experience in loyalty, martech, adtech, or a comparable data-rich B2B domain

About Kobie

Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We re always looking for talented individuals ready to join a collaborative, growth-focused culture.

As a trusted partner to some of the world s most recognized brands, we are loyalty leaders, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers. We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level.As we launch our India Tech Hub, we are excited to bring our award-winning culture to a new region - creating an environment where collaboration, flexibility, and career growth come together to build something truly special.

We are proud to be the only loyalty provider to be externally recognized for their culture. We believe people thrive when they feel valued, supported, and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion ensures every teammate has a voice and the opportunity to be heard.
Giving back is in our DNA at Kobie,through an annual fundraiser, charitable partnerships, and volunteer opportunities, we encourage our teammates to make a difference in their communities.

To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. We understand the importance of time for life outside of work - recognizing public holidays,offering flexible time off, and prioritizing work-life balance.

As we expand into India, our new teammates will be fully integrated with our U.S. teams, working on global projects and gaining exposure to top industry leaders. With continued growth, we will establish a physical office in Bengaluru, India, giving teammates aspace for collaboration and fostering connection.

Piaxis builds AI agents for the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry. We're solving a $150B problem in US construction documentation that remains largely untouched by software.
